chapters.title: Why the model matters more than the chart

takeaways: Every Power BI report runs on a semantic model that holds the tables, relationships and DAX measures behind the visuals.
A star schema with fact tables in the middle and dimension tables around them keeps models fast and trustworthy.
Choose Import, DirectQuery or Direct Lake per table based on data size and freshness, and share certified models instead of rebuilding them.
hook: Many Power BI dashboards look fine while their numbers quietly drift apart. This beginner episode opens up the semantic model behind every report: tables, relationships, DAX measures, star schema and storage modes. Report builders learn how to make data fast, fresh and trusted, and why one shared certified model beats five private ones.
